title: WISE: A Long-Horizon Agent in Minecraft with Why-Which Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.12852v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rapid advances have been made in developing general-purpose embodied agent in environments like Minecraft through the adoption of LLM-augmented hierarchical approaches. Despite their promise, low-level controllers often become performance bottlenecks due to repeated execution failures. We argue that a key limitation is not only the lack of episodic memory, but also the decoupling of \textit{what-where-when} memory from \textit{which-why} reasoning. To address this, we propose \textbf{WISE} (Which-Why Informed Semantic Explorer), a long-horizon agent framework with an enhanced low-level controller equipped with a Causal Event Graph that augments episodic memory with explicit causal structure linking observations to task relevance. Unlike prior work such as MrSteve, which relies on feature similarity for retrieval, WISE enables robust recall under viewpoint changes and supports opportunistic task reordering through causal reasoning. translated_title: WISE：一个基于“哪个-为何”推理的Minecraft长时程智能体
translated_abstract: 通过采用LLM增强的分层方法，在Minecraft等环境中开发通用具身智能体方面已取得快速进展。尽管这些方法前景广阔，但底层控制器常因反复执行失败而成为性能瓶颈。我们认为，一个关键局限不仅在于缺乏情节记忆，还在于“什么-哪里-何时”记忆与“哪个-为何”推理的脱节。为解决这一问题，我们提出了WISE（Which-Why Informed Semantic Explorer，基于“哪个-为何”信息的语义探索器），这是一个长时程智能体框架，其增强的底层控制器配备了因果事件图，通过显式的因果结构将观察与任务相关性联系起来，从而增强情节记忆。与以往依赖特征相似性进行检索的MrSteve等工作不同，WISE能够在视角变化下实现稳健的记忆召回，并通过因果推理支持机会性的任务重新排序。
tldr: WISE提出了一种配备因果事件图的Minecraft长时程智能体框架，通过将情节记忆与“哪个-为何”因果推理相结合，解决了底层控制器反复执行失败的瓶颈，实现了视角变化下的稳健记忆召回和机会性任务重排。
en_tdlr: WISE proposes a long-horizon Minecraft agent framework equipped with a Causal Event Graph that couples episodic memory with which-why reasoning, enabling robust recall under viewpoint changes and opportunistic task reordering to overcome low-level controller execution failures.
